Bracket.title: Knockout bracket
Bracket.intro: Pick a winner for every matchup, Round of 32 through the Final.
Bracket.lockedComplete: Locked in — your completed bracket was accepted.
Bracket.lockedIncomplete: Locked — your bracket was incomplete and is frozen as-is.
Bracket.submittedNote: Submitted — you can update until the bracket locks.
Bracket.emptyState: Teams are not available yet. Please check back later.

Finals.title: Final predictions
Finals.intro: Pick the four tournament-wide winners — champion, runner-up, top scorer, and best player — before the first match kicks off. Each pick is independently editable until the lock boundary.
Finals.topScorerDesc: Player with the most tournament goals.

Leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
Leaderboard.intro: Standings refresh automatically as matches finish. Ties break by exact-result count, then outcome-only count, then final-predictions points.
Leaderboard.emptyState: The leaderboard will populate once matches finish. Until then, all participants are tied at zero.
Leaderboard.yourRank: You are at rank {rank} with {points} pts.
Leaderboard.tieChainIntro: Two or more participants share rank {rank}. Ties are broken in this order (top to bottom). Equal at every level = still tied.

Matches.title: Matches
Matches.intro: FIFA World Cup 2026 fixtures, grouped by stage. Kickoff times are localized to your browser; the canonical schedule remains in UTC.
Matches.noMatches: No matches for the current filters.

Dashboard.intro: Submit your match predictions, lock in your tournament finals, and chase the leaderboard. It's the Nortal prediction pool — loud, friendly, and a little ridiculous.
Dashboard.matchesDesc: Browse the fixture catalog and lock in your score predictions before kickoff.
Dashboard.leaderboardDesc: See the tournament-wide ranking and how you stack up against your peers.
Dashboard.finalsDesc: Pick the champion, runner-up, top scorer, and best player before the first kickoff.
Dashboard.breakdownDesc: See exactly how your points were earned, match by match.

Landing.title: World Cup Madness
Landing.intro: Internal Nortal prediction pool. Sign in with your approved Nortal corporate identity to start picking match scores, locking your tournament finals, and chasing the leaderboard.
Landing.accessNote: Access is restricted to approved Nortal corporate identities.

Footer.tagline: World Cup Madness — Nortal prediction pool
